scope: Same-anchor projected area, opening, floor area and depth matched. Specular geometric optics and assigned scalar absorptance, no measured TA2, film, wavelength or temperature.

definitions.q: Power relative to a blackbody of the same unit-cell footprint emitting into the full hemisphere.
definitions.eta: Cone share of the structure's own hemispherical output.
definitions.x_axis_receiver_sweep: Fixed 15° half-angle on interpolated x–z cut; positive axis points along +x (phi=0), negative along −x (phi=180). The 1° tilt increment is post-processing, not 1° ray sampling or a 2D search for an optimal receiver axis.
definitions.q_rank: Same-anchor comparisons at fixed cone and surface. Ties within ray/angular error are not resolved.
definitions.groove_invariant_quadrature: Independent hemisphere diagnostic for the y-invariant, x-symmetric T0 groove. Collapse saved directions to beta=atan2(sin(theta)*cos(phi),cos(theta)); average repeats in u=|sin(beta)| and integrate in u. Does not overwrite sampled-grid cone ranks or add solves.
